title: Hazard analysis and FMEA update for the Integrated Harness and recent findings
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. New design elements (Integrated Harness, self-retracting tethers, 4 kN absorber, water-ride exclusion) have been added since the hazard analysis and FMEA were written. Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Review hazard-analysis.md and fmea.md against the current design and add or update rows (e.g., Integrated Harness interference with OTSRs, reel lock-up failure, absorber mis-deployment, sizing errors).
acceptanceCriteria: Every new design element in concepts.md has at least one hazard and FMEA row
Each row maps to REQ and test IDs that exist
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
